Import photographs

Choose a batch exported from Apple Photos, put the photos in order, and add them to your private preview.

Choose photos from your exported folder. Batches of 50–100 work well. Each file can be up to 100 MB.

Review and arrange

Use the arrows or enter a position to move a photo. Leave its text blank to use the gallery name and photo number.

    Prepare a GitHub review

    Open your gallery preview first. Then check the changes and create a draft review on GitHub. You decide when to merge it and publish.
